clock_rule: phone frame = latest frame captured at or before event_time + offset
geometry: event and reconstruction panels rotated 180 degrees from raw sensor (mug upright, right of centre, as in the phone)

events.colors: orange positive, blue negative, purple both; strength min(1, log1p(count)/log1p(4))

reconstruction.driver: artifacts/defense_cup_movie_20261121/causal_p1.py (batch check vs run_cup_movie.m results.mat in causal_validation.json)
reconstruction.causal: frame at time t uses only events with timestamp <= t (growing-prefix solve, last value)
reconstruction.config: P1: Gaussian sigma 5 ms, sigmoid/sqrt 0.03, N=300 over 1.019-1.750 s (2.44 ms spacing)

display.rule: histogram mode -> 0.4, half 1st-99th percentile range -> 0.45, clip [0,1]
